All three files already `#include <iostream>`, so no additional includes needed. Added the debug line before all 4 direct call sites of `AuthToken::validate`:

- `src/web/auth_controller.cpp` — `handleLogin` (line 13) and `handleRefresh` (line 26)
- `src/web/session_controller.cpp` — `handle` (line 12)
- `src/auth/auth_service.cpp` — `login` (line 14)

Note: `ast-tool callers`/`references` reported zero results for `AuthToken::validate` (a resolver gap with reference-typed member calls), so I verified the 4 call sites manually by reading each caller and confirming `token_` is `auth::AuthToken&` in each case. `AuthService::validate` (auth_service.cpp:31) is a distinct method and was correctly left untouched.
